mapping.name: Terraforming Directorate Bonds
mapping.description: Unlocks a paid Directorate Bonds planet component on developed colonies. While fitted: +10% local commerce income; one slot. No empire-wide income bonus.

mapping.name: Closed-Loop Habitat Engineering
mapping.description: Reduces civilian colony development-track build times by 10%. Does not alter ship production.

mapping.name: Precision Manufacturing
mapping.description: Unlocks two discounted equipment supply contracts: Combat Repair System and Antimatter Engine, each 10% cheaper in ordinary resources. Their native effects and exotic costs are unchanged.

mapping.name: MMC Assault Certification
mapping.description: Adds one second to trained Scirocco Marine Breaching Teams disruption (13 to 14 seconds). Movement/firing penalties, protection and capture probabilities are unchanged.

mapping.name: Redundant Command Systems
mapping.description: Unlocks a paid capital/command component providing +15% antimatter capacity. No damage, shield, reload or regeneration bonus.

mapping.name: Lunar Procurement Offices
mapping.description: Unlocks a paid developed-colony procurement office. While fitted it increases local factory production rate by 10% (build time divided by 1.10).

mapping.name: Emergency Appropriations
mapping.description: Unlocks a paid local mobilization office. Manual activation costs 300 credits, 100 metal and 50 crystal for +20% local shipbuilding rate for 30 seconds; 180-second cooldown. Incompatible with passive Lunar Procurement on the same planet.

mapping.name: Civilian Shipping Requisition
mapping.description: Increases ordinary trade credit, metal and crystal income by 5%. Preserves existing trade shipping; grants no combat escorts or free ships.

mapping.name: Black-Budget Procurement
mapping.description: Authorizes paid Amun-Ra construction. Normal 4,000 credits / 750 metal / 500 crystal, 90-second build time and 70 supply remain; maximum six owned hulls. Grants no free ship.

mapping.name: Fleet Train Organization
mapping.description: Unlocks a paid targeted repair component for capitals and command ships. 200 hull maximum over 20 seconds within 2,000 range; same-effect repair cannot stack with Scirocco teams. No reload reset.

mapping.name: Volatile Recovery Cooperatives
mapping.description: Adds 15% metal and crystal income from orbital extractors. Does not multiply mining-track income, market transactions or salvage rewards.

mapping.name: Spin-Habitat Construction
mapping.description: Reduces logistics-track development time by 10% on asteroid and ice-asteroid colonies. Does not discount ships, rail batteries or other orbital structures.

mapping.name: Override-Code Libraries
mapping.description: Increases the existing Amun/Europa guarded boarding range by 5% (6,000 to 6,300). Requires ownership of a compatible hull; no capture-probability, health-threshold or protection change.

mapping.name: Diverted Martian Surplus
mapping.description: Authorizes one paid Pella command capital per player. Full ordinary/exotic prices, construction time and 200 supply remain. Does not unlock the MCRN production tree.

deferred.name: Naval Readiness Program

deferred.name: Orbital Defense Command

deferred.name: Dockworker Damage Control
deferred.reason: Requires bounded local tender/engineering equipment; no free Artemis aura or empire heal.

deferred.name: Salvage Arbitration
deferred.reason: Requires reward-specific ordinary material adjustment excluding rare samples/scuttle rewards.
